recognize_zh: 這是腦部 MRI 軸切面 FLAIR：右顳葉與左顳枕葉各有一個高訊號病灶，中央有較低訊號的圓形區，周圍水腫明顯。移植後免疫低下病人出現多發病灶，要想到弓漿蟲（toxoplasmosis）。
features: Axial FLAIR MRI of the brain (non-microscopic image)
Bilateral hyperintense lesions in the right temporal lobe and left temporo-occipital region
Central rounded lower-signal focus within each lesion producing a target-like appearance
Surrounding vasogenic edema without marked midline shift
Contrast enhancement pattern cannot be assessed on this single FLAIR slice
describe_en: Axial FLAIR MRI of the brain shows two separate hyperintense lesions involving the right temporal lobe and the left temporo-occipital region, each with a central rounded focus of lower signal and surrounding edema. No significant midline shift is seen on this slice. Enhancement characteristics cannot be evaluated without post-contrast images. In a post-HSCT patient with seizures, multifocal lesions of this type are suggestive of cerebral toxoplasmosis, to be confirmed by Toxoplasma PCR, serology and response to therapy.

ddx.dx: Primary or secondary CNS lymphoma / PTLD
ddx.vs: Lymphoma is more often solitary, periventricular or subependymal with homogeneous enhancement and restricted diffusion, and is thallium/PET-avid, unlike toxoplasmosis.
Angioinvasive fungal lesions tend to be hemorrhagic and at gray-white junctions; distinction requires CSF/tissue studies such as galactomannan.
PML involves subcortical white matter without mass effect or target-like enhancement and is JC virus PCR-positive.
